entities.name: PMID:25080456
observations: 2014 multicenter retrospective cohort analysis of prospectively entered OUTCOMEREA ICU data; 3,257 ICU stays from January 1997 to October 2012.
Included patients intubated within 72 hours and staying in ICU longer than 3 days.

entities.name: Delayed nutrition in obesity
observations: Among 3,257 critically ill patients, nutrition initiation delay differed by BMI group (P=0.035) and was longer in obese patients (BMI ≥30 kg/m²; n=663).

Adjusted relative risk for delayed initiation versus normal weight was 1.06 (95% CI 1.00–1.12) in obese patients; overall adjusted analysis reported P=0.004, independent of age, sex, diabetes, and other chronic diseases.
Authors concluded that initiation of nutritional support was delayed in obese ICU patients.
